cross_lane_bridge.meaning: 'selected by W(3,3)' = stable under the Eisenstein order-3 element J

refuted.claim: A2-orthogonality gives a cheaper collinearity computation

spreads.meaning: a complete set of 10 MUBs in dimension 9; a partition of the 240 roots into 10 orthogonal A2 quadruples

the_40_is_not_distinguished: every fixed-point-free order-3 element stabilises exactly 40 A2s, so E8 carries a family of W(3,3)s indexed by those elements
